annotation.authors_or_issuer: Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), U.S. Department of Transportation
key_provisions_or_claims: Pilot in command is directly responsible and final authority for aircraft operation (91.3).
Right-of-way, minimum safe altitude, speed and airspace class operating rules (91.113-91.135).
Special flight rules for Grand Canyon, including flight-free zones and minimum altitudes (SFAR 50-2).
Temporary flight restrictions via NOTAM for disasters, events and space operations.
Equipment, recorder (CVR/FDR), and RVSM requirements; excludes part 107 small UAS except specific sections (91.1(f)).
annotation.summary_en: Text of 14 CFR Part 91, the FAA's General Operating and Flight Rules for U.S. civil aircraft, including Special Federal Aviation Regulations (Grand Canyon, ATC emergency operation, Alaska RNAV), right-of-way, altitude, airspace class, equipment and RVSM rules. It concerns conventional piloted aviation, with only a passing exclusion of part 107 drones.
